property_summary: After any sequence of operations ending with Collect, the contract's balance should never be greater than the sum of all user balances (i.e., no minting of ether).

After a Collect call, the total of all user balances (sum over Acc) must not exceed the contract's ether balance plus the sum of all user balances before the call, ensuring no balance was underflowed.
The contract's total balance (sum over all accounts) must not decrease after a Collect call that does not revert.

After any sequence ending with Collect, the sum of all account balances must not exceed the total ether balance of the contract plus the sum of all account balances before the sequence (preventing overflow inflation).

After a Collect call, the caller's balance is always less than or equal to the previous maximum possible balance (accounting for overflow wrap-around), specifically the difference between the caller's balance before and after Collect is exactly the amount withdrawn (no more).
The balance of msg.sender after a successful Collect should equal the sum of all Put deposits minus the collected amount, considering unlockTime constraints.
After a call to Collect, the caller's balance in contract C is non-negative (i.e., >= 0).
After Collect(uint256) reverts, the balance of the caller in the contract is exactly equal to the sum of all Put deposits made by that caller.
After Collect, the unlockTime of the caller is unchanged if the collect reverts.
After a successful Collect, the caller's unlockTime equals the maximum of all unlockTimes set by the caller's Put calls, or block.timestamp if no Put was made.
After a Collect call with a given amount, the contract's balance changes by exactly that amount only if the caller's balance was at least MinSum before the withdrawal.

After a Collect call with a given amount, the caller's account balance in the contract (c.Acc(caller).balance) decreases by exactly the amount only if the caller's balance was at least MinSum before the withdrawal; otherwise it stays unchanged.
When calling Collect with an amount less than MinSum, the caller's account balance in the contract remains unchanged.
Collect always leaves caller's balance unchanged when amount is less than MinSum
Collect reverts when caller's balance is zero regardless of unlock time and amount
A collect should only succeed when the current timestamp is strictly greater than the unlock time, not when it equals it.
The balance of a holder after a successful Collect call must be strictly less than its previous balance by exactly the amount collected.
After a Collect call, the contract's total balance must equal the sum of all holders' balances.

After a Collect call, the caller's balance reported by Acc(caller).unlockTime must equal the unlockTime set by the most recent Put call if the Collect did not revert, even when block.timestamp equals the unlock time.
A Collect call succeeds only when block.timestamp is strictly greater than acc.unlockTime, not when equal.
After a Collect call, the balance of the caller should decrease exactly by the amount requested (not by 1).
After a Collect call with _am == 0, the caller's balance before and after the call must be equal.
The total sum of all balances in the Acc mapping is equal to the contract's ether balance.
After Collect, the recorded event value in LogFile matches the amount sent to the caller.
After any Collect call, the recorded event value in LogFile equals the amount actually subtracted from the user's balance.
After any call to Collect, the contract's ether balance does not decrease, because it sends zero value instead of the requested amount.
After calling Collect(uint256) with a requested amount, if the call succeeds, the caller's balance increases by exactly the amount specified in the function parameter (not zero).
After a successful Collect call, the balance of the caller increases by exactly the parameter _am, not zero.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance increases by exactly the parameter _am, not zero.
After a successful Collect(_am) call, the caller's balance increases by the amount _am, not zero.
Calling Collect with any amount does not change the MinSum state variable.
Calling Collect does not change MinSum.
After any call to Collect, MinSum remains greater than or equal to 1 ether.
After any call to Collect, MinSum is never decreased from its initial value of 1 ether.
After any call to Collect, MinSum equals the initial value of 1 ether.
